svg.title: Жим гири лёжа двумя руками — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Make both hands clearly visible holding the SAME single kettlebell, one hand on each horn of its handle. Use head-end elevated 3/4 view so both forearms and grips visibly separate. Left both elbows bent, upper arms on floor. Right both elbows nearly straight, bell above chest. Both figures lie face up on floor, no bench. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
